description: Uploads a short video (mp4, quicktime or webm, up to 100 MB) from an https `url` or a local file `path` and returns it in state "processing". It is not posted yet: read it with salt_get_media until `state` is ready, then post it with salt_publish_video. Each call makes a new asset. Needs a creator account (an admin sets that) and the video switches open; otherwise Salt answers 404 or 403 and the sentence comes back as the error.

byte_size.description: The file's exact size in bytes, if you know it. Saves a size check against the URL first.

content_type.description: Needed only if the URL's response does not say.

path.description: A video file on this computer. Use this or url.

url.description: A public https URL to the video file.

name: salt_upload_video

state.description: uploading, processing, ready, failed or removed.

title: Upload Video
